name: audit-fixture-vue-3-ecosystem
_comment: Phase 2 hoisted compat audit. Peer-heavy fixture: Vue 3 ecosystem analogue to React's react-ssr fixture. Vue + Pinia (state) + vue-router. Pinia and vue-router both declare vue as a peer dep — same instance-invariant risk as ReactDOM/React, just on the other major framework. The Vue 3 reactive system is module-scoped (similar to React's hooks dispatcher), so cross-instance use crashes loudly.
